placebo_1.name: OUTCOME_SHUFFLE_WITHIN_BLOCK
placebo_1.method: permute the per-trade outcome within (object x calendar-month) blocks, preserving the feature panel and the trade timestamps; rerun the FULL stage-1 pipeline
placebo_1.pass_criterion: the BH-FDR discovery rate under the null must be <= q (0.05) +/- Monte-Carlo error; if the pipeline routinely manufactures 'rescue' cells under shuffled outcomes, V2 STOPS

placebo_2.name: FEATURE_ASSIGNMENT_SHUFFLE
placebo_2.method: permute the feature-vector-to-trade assignment within each object; any condition that survives is a property of the payoff shape, not of the feature

placebo_3.name: SYNTHETIC_POSITIVE_CONTROL
placebo_3.method: inject a known conditional effect (+0.3R on one randomly chosen blinded feature's top bin) and confirm the pipeline recovers it at the declared power

rule: all three run BEFORE any real result is interpreted
